problems.title: Single Number
problems.notes: XOR cancels pairs (a^a=0, a^0=a) — the pattern's namesake problem, O(n) time O(1) space

problems.title: Number of 1 Bits
problems.notes: n & (n-1) clears the lowest set bit — know this trick cold, it reappears constantly in bit-manipulation problems

problems.title: Power of Two
problems.notes: n & (n-1) == 0 reuses the same lowest-set-bit trick to check for exactly one bit set

problems.title: Single Number II
problems.notes: count bits mod 3 per position when every other number appears exactly 3 times — plain XOR no longer works

problems.title: Single Number III
problems.notes: XOR everything, take any set bit to split numbers into two groups, then XOR each group separately

problems.title: Sum of Two Integers
problems.notes: add without +/-: XOR is the sum-without-carry, (AND << 1) is the carry — loop until the carry reaches zero

problems.title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in an Array
problems.notes: build a bit-trie greedily from the highest bit down, always trying to branch into the opposite bit at each level
